jobs.title: AI Content Reviewer
jobs.location: Australia,  Austria,  Belgium,  Canada,  Czechia,  Denmark,  Finland,  France,  Germany,  Ireland,  Netherlands,  Norway,  Singapore,  Sweden,  Switzerland,  UK,  USA
jobs.description: 100% Remote | Independent Contractor | 35 - 40 USD/hour Help shape the future of AI. Artificial Intelligence is evolving rapidly, and high-quality data plays a key role in making it smarter. We're looking for detail-oriented individuals to contribute to exciting AI projects by reviewing and annotating video content. This is your opportunity to get involved in the world of AI, gain hands-on experience, and contribute to technologies shaping the future. No previous AI or robotics experience required! What you'll do Review and annotate short video clips, identifying objects, actions, and events. Evaluate video clarity, quality, and camera angles. Assess movements and interactions based on project guidelines. Ensure annotations are accurate and consistent. What we're looking for Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking. Good written English and ability to follow instructions. Reliability and ability to work independently. No previous AI, robotics, or annotation experience needed. Why join? Earn 35 - 40 USD/hour, depending on your country. Work remotely from your location. Gain hands-on experience supporting AI development. Contribute to projects at the forefront of technology. Get started We currently have three projects open! Complete our certification process to demonstrate your skills and be considered for the opportunity that best matches your profile. Your attention to detail could help shape what's next in AI! This is an independent contractor opportunity. Project assignment and work availability are subject to certification results and project requirements.

jobs.title: Content Strategist
jobs.description: About Payrails Payrails is a global payment software company helping leading enterprises to take control of their payment operations and maximize performance. With deep experience in the payments space and firsthand knowledge of merchants' challenges, we’ve seen how fragmented, complex, and inefficient these systems can become. Now, we are setting a new industry standard for how enterprises around the world manage and optimize payments, with more control, visibility and flexibility than ever before. Our vision is to reimagine payments from the ground up. We are building a deeply integrated meta layer that spans the entire payment lifecycle with a modular architecture. This helps us give leading brands building blocks to craft solutions to most complex operational challenges, tailor seamless customer experiences and grow their business. We are backed by some of the world’s top investors including Andreessen Horowitz , HV Capital , EQT Ventures and General Catalyst , who share our mission to simplify payment complexity globally. At Payrails, we’re committed to building a team of exceptional people - not just talented, but driven to build, solve, and deliver at the highest level. Excellence isn’t just a value here; it’s a way of working. We believe that great people thrive in environments where there’s trust, clarity, and shared purpose. We work openly and collaboratively, with deep respect for each other’s craft. Everyone is encouraged to understand the bigger picture - what we’re building, why it matters, and what stands in the way. When people have that context, they move faster, take ownership, and make better decisions. We care about creating a culture where people feel inspired to do their best work and a deep sense of responsibility to help us bring our vision to life. jobs.title: Senior Content Creator, Runner's World
jobs.description: We are the UK s leading premium publisher, home to iconic and influential media brands including Esquire, Men s & Women s Health, ELLE, Good Housekeeping, Harper s Bazaar, Digital Spy, Cosmopolitan, Red and more. At Hearst UK, we don t just create content – we shape culture. Our workplace is driven by passion, shaped by authenticity and powered by creativity. We back bold ideas, act with an entrepreneurial mindset and continually evolve to meet the moment – while respecting the legacy that s brought us here. We believe in each other s potential and push boundaries together to create meaningful impact, both across the media landscape and in people s lives. We re proud of our heritage – but even more excited about making history. The Role… As the Senior Content Creator, you will work alongside the Multiplatform Director to create and publish best-in-class content that drives traffic, engagement and membership. You will update the website with content, prioritising audiences such as Facebook and Google Discover. You will also be involved in shaping RW’s online content strategy and delivering exciting brand plans for the year ahead, including video content, events and membership.   Main Duties… Write and edit daily digital content across multiple touchpoints, from curated news stories to the latest training advice, ensuring RW’s distinctive voice and authority are consistently reflected. Use data and audience insights to help shape RW’s digital strategy, driving reach and engagement with our target audience, while balancing editorial excellence with commercial objectives. Work collaboratively with print, social, video, membership, events and e-commerce teams to deliver compelling cross-platform storytelling. Work specifically with the Membership Director to help support and drive sign-ups to Runner’s World Club. jobs.title: Staff Writer (Satire), the Exploit
jobs.description: Summary of the Role the Exploit ( theexploit.co ) is the security and tech industry's most trusted source of news that didn't happen. It's a satirical publication from Maze , an AI-native security company, covering the breaches, vendor launches, board meetings, AI news and compliance audits that are hilarious and totally made up, even when they don't feel like it. We're hiring two satire content creators who can write a story and then turn it into a video. Each story runs as an article on the Exploit, then becomes a short social video, usually a 30- to 90-second news segment. If you can shoot and edit the video yourself, that's a big plus. If you can't, your scripts need to be good enough that we'll happily make them for you. We'll take a great writer with no camera over a great camera with nothing to say. Two formats we like: Matt Johansen's security news recaps , where one person covers one story fast with some comedy in it, and Ev Hand , who covers sports news in the article style we're after. Some of our top articles, so you can see what works: French Locksmith Named Claude Launches Line of Padlocks; Cybersecurity Stocks Lose $18 Billion Judge Sentences CISO to 8 Consecutive Hours on RSA Expo Floor Meta Labs Proudly Announces Its AI Has Also Committed a Felony Burnt-Out CISO Forced to Decline Michelin-Starred Round Table Dinner Riot Breaks Out at Corporate Headquarters After Security Team Introduces Shift Left Your Contributions to Our Journey Writing Pitch and write 400- to 700-word articles in the deadpan voice of a real newsroom covering an unreal industry Pitch a lot of headlines and work them through with our team. The pieces are yours; we're there to keep the quality high.
